in_english.name: Tazkiya
in_english.meaning: A term in Islam that refers to the purification of the heart and the purification of intentions and deeds
in_english.long_meaning: Tazkiya is a term in Islam that refers to the purification of the heart and the purification of intentions and deeds. It is derived from the Arabic root t-z-k, which means to purify or cleanse. In Islamic tradition, Tazkiya is considered a means of achieving spiritual growth and self-purification. It is a concept that is deeply rooted in Islamic theology and is often associated with the idea of spiritual purification.
